apiKeys.label: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Authenticate requests to the tomomai API using these keys.
apiKeys.emptySuffix: to start using the tomomai API.
apiKeys.regeneratedDescription: Copy your new API key now. It will not be shown again.
apiKeys.regeneratedSaveWarning: Save this key — it won't be shown again after closing this dialog.

regenerateDialog.title: Regenerate API key?
regenerateDialog.description: This will immediately invalidate the current key. Any application using it will lose access until updated with the new key.

deleteDialog.title: Delete API key?
deleteDialog.description: This action cannot be undone. Any application using this key will immediately lose access.

createDialog.title: Create API Key
createDialog.description: Generate a new API key to access the tomomai API.
createDialog.createdDescription: Copy your API key now. It will not be shown again.
createDialog.saveWarning: Save this key — it won't be shown again after closing this dialog.
createDialog.nameDescription: A descriptive name to identify this key.
createDialog.sensitiveWarning: One or more selected scopes are marked sensitive because they expose personal data or private identifiers. Grant only to apps you trust.
createDialog.destructiveWarning: This key grants access to destructive operations. Do you understand the risks?

ready.name: Ready
ready.description: Basic access. Grants GET /api/v1/ok. Included by default.

user:metadata:read.name: User Metadata (Read)
user:metadata:read.description: Read your username, region, profile visibility, and role. Grants GET /api/v1/me.

snapshot:latest:metadata:read.name: Latest Snapshot Metadata (Read)
snapshot:latest:metadata:read.description: Read metadata (rating, display name, play counts, etc.) for your latest snapshot. Grants GET /api/v1/snapshots/latest.

snapshot:latest:songs:b50:read.name: Latest Snapshot B50 Songs (Read)
snapshot:latest:songs:b50:read.description: Read the B50 song scores (best 50) from your latest snapshot.

snapshot:latest:songs:read.name: Latest Snapshot All Songs (Read)
snapshot:latest:songs:read.description: Read all song scores from your latest snapshot.

snapshot:latest:events:read.name: Latest Snapshot Events (Read)
snapshot:latest:events:read.description: Read event progress data from your latest snapshot.

snapshot:latest:icon:read.name: Latest Snapshot Icon (Read)
snapshot:latest:icon:read.description: Read your profile icon URL (Discord avatar) from your latest snapshot. Sensitive — may reveal your social identity.

snapshot:all:metadata:read.name: All Snapshots Metadata (Read)
snapshot:all:metadata:read.description: List all your snapshots and read their metadata. Grants GET /api/v1/snapshots and GET /api/v1/snapshots/:id.

snapshot:all:songs:b50:read.name: All Snapshots B50 Songs (Read)
snapshot:all:songs:b50:read.description: Read the B50 song scores from any of your snapshots.

snapshot:all:songs:read.name: All Snapshots All Songs (Read)
snapshot:all:songs:read.description: Read all song scores from any of your snapshots.

snapshot:all:events:read.name: All Snapshots Events (Read)
snapshot:all:events:read.description: Read event progress data from any of your snapshots.

snapshot:all:icon:read.name: All Snapshots Icon (Read)
snapshot:all:icon:read.description: Read your profile icon URL (Discord avatar) from any snapshot. Sensitive — may reveal your social identity.

recent:read.name: Recent Plays (Read)
recent:read.description: Read your recent play history including song info, achievement, and combo/sync status. Grants GET /api/v1/recents.

recent:detailed:read.name: Recent Plays Detailed (Read)
recent:detailed:read.description: Adds venue and full per-note-type breakdown to recent play results.

stats:read.name: Stats (Read)
stats:read.description: Read your grade/FC/FS distribution statistics. Grants GET /api/v1/stats.

album:read.name: Albums (Read)
album:read.description: Read your arcade photo album entries (metadata only, no image URLs). Grants GET /api/v1/albums.

album:images:read.name: Album Images (Read)
album:images:read.description: Adds resolved image URLs to album responses. Sensitive — photos may contain images of people.

snapshot:latest:read.name: Latest Snapshot (Read)
snapshot:latest:read.description: Grants metadata, song scores, and events for your latest snapshot only. Excludes icon (opt-in for privacy).

snapshot:all:read.name: All Snapshots (Read)
snapshot:all:read.description: Grants metadata, song scores, and events for all your snapshots, including the latest. Excludes icon (opt-in for privacy).

read.name: Read (All Non-Sensitive)
read.description: Broad read access: user metadata, all snapshots, recents, stats, and albums. Excludes icon and album image URLs. Sensitive due to broad personal data access.
